research_arc.sentence: **Research arc: all three asks were priced and none paid.** E25 IRRECOVERABLE (+0.25pp best arm `smooth_k2`), E26 MIXED_ACROSS_PHASES (+0.73pp best arm `excl_upgap_q80`), E27 NO_SLICING_EDGE (+0.06pp best arm `k5`). So the gap between the printed number and the tradable one is not recoverable by smoothing the score, not visible in the overnight gap, and not saved by slicing the fill over k opens. This is not a claim that no lever exists -- it is the narrower, earned claim that these three do not pay, and that a fourth question has to come from somewhere other than this rule's own mechanics.

caveats: this prices one exchange and one exchange back at the horizon; it is not a book backtest -- nothing else moves, and no other name is re-ranked inside the horizon
the harvest is a better entry into the same basket, not a realised gain: what the pair hands back is what decides whether a second exchange pays for its own four sides

with no premium anchor the path measured is the price ratio, not the premium; pairs whose ratio trends are refused upstream by the census year gate, and that premise is stated here rather than assumed
the ticket size is a stated 100,000 CNY, not this book's traded notional -- the board's answer is per comparable ticket, so two pairs are comparable to each other
the pairs are alternatives to one another, not a portfolio: the board total adds up the harvest of many pairs, and one ticket can only make one of those choices
a cohort member whose forward window is not inside the panel is censored, never scored as a zero change

width is measured from the pair's own window median, so the unknown NAV-base constant cancels; that also means the face never claims to know which of the two tickers is the expensive one on a pair with no premium anchor

alias_stability.sentence: 今天这张盘口有 867 对异名同篮；把同样两道门放到前 4 个年度窗上重问一遍，每窗只留下（T-1y 57.2%、T-2y 57.0%、T-3y 54.1%、T-4y 50.9%），能数到的 538 对里 137 对每窗都过（25.5%），401 对被某一窗拒过（日级 35 对 / 年级 394 对），329 对历史不够没法问——判词 WINDOW_LUCK。把每个历史窗当独立抽样，每窗 55.5% 的通过率下这些对应该活下来 139.6 对，实测 137 对——所以这不是「某些对不稳」而是这道年级线落在刀口上。过 0.50pp 物质线的 2 组一共 1,311 元的选择成本，其中每一对都过所有窗的只有 694 元。

crosscheck.note: 同一窗不同宇宙（普查面 577 票 / 本面 581 票）：面板在普查面写完之后又落了新票，差在宇宙不在规则

caveats: the earlier windows re-ask the SAME two gates of the SAME two tickers; a pair that holds in all of them is stable in price behaviour, not certified as the same asset
earlier windows carry membership only: premiums exist for one session on this board, so no earlier money number is published (a prior-year cost would be invented)
the screen is today's: a ticker that only began trading two years ago drops out of the earlier windows by name and is counted as not measurable, never as a hold
the drift line is still the census's chosen 1.0 pp; this face measures whether the verdicts move, not whether the line is the right one
windows are disjoint and exactly 250 sessions; the panel's own holiday calendar decides what a session is

floor_provenance.sentence: the floor is not a version of the rule: k*beta == 0.2000 on all 5 cells, so the floor is the target divided by the largest beta measured -- issued by `universe` (1665 bars). Of the -20.74pp between the widest floor (k=0.460253) and the narrowest (k=0.667665), -23.55pp (114%) comes from shrinking the window from the full panel to 1665 bars and only 2.81pp from grading the universe on that same short stretch (2.81pp if the universe is graded on the full panel); the two knobs interact by -5.14pp. Read as money on CNY 1,000,000 NAV: the window alone accounts for CNY -235,470 of the gap.

the floor's own drift as the window slides: today's 306 bars end 2026-10-14, so the floor will be re-issued on a different stretch next month

do_or_wait.sentence: nothing is owed today (the ticket orders k under its own permission), so the baseline is 'do nothing'. doing it today is the cheapest rung of the ladder (every wait is more expensive); across k=1..10 the waits span +1808 .. +4071 CNY vs today. One open late is worth -932 CNY of NAV on the median sheet with waiting helping on 41% of them (t=-4.60), so the mean is priced but a single sheet is still a coin flip.

identity_scope.note: The control arms are re-priced on the bar the operator page priced; the dial cells are untouched and stay on this face's own panel. Comparing a face priced on today's bar against one priced on the feed's last complete bar measures the feed's lag, not the arm. Consequence, and it is a real limit: while the two bars differ, the dial prices explain this face's own three rows, not the three rows printed on the page that day.
